name: Reality Bridge Synaptic Core Contract
purpose: A deterministic, host-neutral software state element for signal memory, coupling and reward-modulated adaptation.
scope: Biologically inspired naming only; this contract does not claim to reproduce a biological synapse, nervous system or consciousness.
pulse: drive = input * weight + pending_coupling + modulation * trace
reinforcement: weight = clamp(weight + plasticity * reward * trace * last_input, weight_min, weight_max)
compatibility_rule: Ports must preserve defaults, clamps, update order and conformance vector within documented floating-point tolerance.
